name: Acmer P3
tagline: Enclosed 20W diode with built-in camera — budget answer to xTool S1
tldr: Acmer packs an enclosed 20W diode, camera preview, and air assist into a sub-$800 package. Performance sits between open-frame budget machines and xTool S1. Worth considering if xTool pricing hurts but you still want enclosure and camera.
mainObjective: Affordable enclosed engraving with camera alignment for home makers

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Enclosed + camera at a lower price than xTool S1
Built-in air assist on many bundles
Large work area for enclosed class
cons: Brand support less proven than xTool
beginnerNotes: Strong alternative to xTool S1 if budget is the deciding factor. Compare warranty and return policy before buying — newer brands vary.
proTips: Use camera for placement but always run material test cards. Upgrade exhaust path if cutting frequently — built-in filters clog faster than ducting outside.
primaryUse: Budget enclosed diode laser for home engraving with camera-assisted alignment and moderate thin-material cutting.
